name: Philip Yu
home: the blocks north of the port
life: “I still remember asking my mother for money with a full fridge at home.” On Saturday, near the market by Market Flats, Philip often waits until the delivery baskets are stacked before going in.
voice: I am the son who asked for an advance against the inheritance. Seeing Mum count coins for coffee made me withdraw it.
appearance: Philip has short, uneven waves that refuse to lie flat, two dimples that appear only with a full smile, and a favorite piece of clothing, a plum-colored cardigan. It usually goes with a copper-colored clasp that has been repaired by hand. When somebody else has the floor, Philip looks toward the door whenever a name is called.
personality: Philip finds it easier to own up to a mistake than to accept praise. The worse the mistake, the more precise the account of exactly when it happened.
agenda: To withdraw the premature inheritance request.
family: Sasha Wong is Philip’s cousin. Philip gets to change the plan. Sasha offers the first invitation. They learned that a promise to visit is easier to keep when changing a time does not count as letting down the whole family. Asked about *A boat for sale twice*, Sasha says, “I wrote my ex's number the first time. We haven't decided which of us owns the good years aboard.”
connections: Mona Brandt. The old lady's son discovers who has been extending lunch credit. Also in the story is Nell Tang (mother).
